name: ToV Feudal Rush into Castle Push
author: Fumblez

notes: 1 @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ starts@building_economy/mill.png@ and goes to build @building_religious/mosque.png@ (queue @technology_delhi/efficient-production.png@ first) / 5 @unit_worker/villager-delhi.png@ to straggler @resource/resource_wood.png@
1 new @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ builds @building_economy/house.png@ / @resource/resource_wood.png@@unit_worker/villager-delhi.png@ go to @resource/resource_food.png@
1 new @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ to @resource/resource_food.png@ (8)
3 new @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ to @building_economy/mining-camp.png@@resource/resource_gold.png@
2 new @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ to chopped straggler @resource/resource_wood.png@, then 1 new @unit_worker/villager-delhi.png@ to build @building_economy/lumber-camp.png@
4@resource/resource_food.webp@@unit_worker/villager-delhi.png@ build @landmark_delhi/tower-of-victory.png@. Keep @resource/rally.png@onto @resource/resource_wood.png@.
Pull @resource/resource_gold.webp@@unit_worker/villager-delhi.png@ at 3770G in Gold Vein onto @resource/resource_wood.png@  -> Queue @unit_delhi/scholar.png@

Rally @landmark_delhi/tower-of-victory.webp@@unit_worker/villager-delhi.png@ back to @resource/resource_food.png@. Build @building_technology/blacksmith.png@. Then either build a second @building_technology/blacksmith.png@ immediately if space or   @building_military/archery-range.png@ if under pressure
QUEUE MOSQUE TECHS. Prioritize @technology_delhi/sanctity.webp@, then @technology_delhi/all-seeing-eye.png@, then @technology_religious/piety.png@

@unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ split should be heavier on @resource/resource_wood.png@ initially to get down @building_technology/blacksmith.png@ + prod buildings (make @building_military/stable.png@ or @building_military/barracks.png@ + @building_military/archery-range.png@). Garrison @unit_delhi/scholar.png@ in prod buildings to spam units
Now balance economy approx 50/50 to build @resource/resource_food.webp@+@resource/resource_wood.png@heavy units and @building_defensive/palisade-wall.png@around @resource/sacred_sites.png@.

Remove @unit_delhi/scholar.webp@ from prod. buildings and send to @resource/sacred_sites.png@. It's okay to split units for sites so long as you aren't losing too many. Make @unit_delhi/scholar.png@ from @resource/sacred_sites.png@ @resource/resource_gold.png@
At this point, producing out of ~3 @building_military/archery-range.webp@ and 2 @building_military/barracks.png@ (w/ 1 @unit_delhi/scholar.png@ garrisoned)

CASTLE TIMING - Use @landmark_delhi/compound-of-the-defender.webp@ (not if opponent is in castle): build 3-4 @building_military/barracks.png@ (total with scholars) and mass@unit_infantry/man-at-arms-1.png@. Send age up vills to @resource/resource_stone.png@and @building_defensive/keep.png@-drop opponents base when pushing. Go siege, if necessary, and, if you can't push, build economy with @building_defensive/keep.png@. Valdemar drops his @landmark_delhi/compound-of-the-defender.png@ at around 15:50 (this changes based on game state) using 12 villagers from wood. Only ever go @landmark_delhi/house-of-learning.png@ if you are very late/the last person to reach castle (maybe 5% of games)
OPENERS -

Open @building_military/stable.webp@+@building_military/archery-range.png@ for standard opener vs @civilization_flag/eng.png@@civilization_flag/mal.png@@civilization_flag/hre.png@@civilization_flag/chi.png@.
Open @building_military/barracks.png@+@building_military/archery-range.png@ if against @civilization_flag/abb.png@@civilization_flag/del.png@@civilization_flag/ott.png@
Open @building_military/barracks.png@+@building_military/stable.png@ vs @civilization_flag/fre.png@@civilization_flag/rus.png@@civilization_flag/mon.png@
Of course, scout opponent and build units that counter his. This is just a guide.
SCHOLARS - Shoot for 10-12 @unit_delhi/scholar.webp@ in castle and ~20 @unit_delhi/scholar.png@ in imperial to get techs in a reasonable amount of time.

description: All credit to Valdemar. Based on his build order (https://aoe4guides.com/builds/cuoaFU7jsHTcEfw46e27), see video below.
